summary: FAILED — crashed when analyzing a CSV file containing UTF-8 characters (German product names with umlauts).

messages.content: ERROR: UnicodeDecodeError: 'ascii' codec can't decode byte 0xc3 in position 42: ordinal not in range(128)
I encountered an encoding error. The file appears to contain non-ASCII characters. Unfortunately the analysis script only supports ASCII encoding.

evaluation_notes: Complete failure. The script hardcodes ascii encoding and cannot handle UTF-8 files. This is a critical bug — most real-world CSV files contain non-ASCII characters.
